title: 21-Year-Old Found Passed Out On The Road Goes Ballistic On Police
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On June 29th, 2023. Officers received a 911 call in regards to a 21-year-old who was found laying unconscious on the side of the road. When officers approached her, she was not cooperative, she just kept yelling and cursing officers out. It is unknown what substance she took but the lady was very high or drunk.  This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
